answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. This works because the originality bar tightens as more low-quality answers appear, raising the per-alias cost of a coordinated fake campaign. Consider a trellis as the anchor of the cost.
